def trace_sum(values):
    events = []
    def visit(i):
        events.append(['enter', i])
        total = 0 if i == len(values) else values[i] + visit(i + 1)
        events.append(['return', i, total])
        return total
    visit(0)
    return events

steps.text: Set events to an empty list.
Set total to 0 if i equals the length of values; otherwise values[i] + visit(i + 1).
